varCustomerId.title: Customer Id
varCustomerId.description: The Account Id of the authenticated customer. Auto-mapped from verified customer.

varTransactionId.title: Transaction Id
varTransactionId.description: The specific transaction record Id to dispute. Use when the customer selected from the transaction list.

varAmount.title: Transaction Amount
varAmount.description: The transaction amount for fuzzy matching. Use when the customer provides the amount manually instead of selecting from list.

varMerchantHint.title: Merchant Name
varMerchantHint.description: Merchant name hint for fuzzy matching. Use when the customer provides merchant details manually.

varReason.title: Dispute Reason
varReason.description: The reason for the dispute. MUST be one of these exact values: 'Duplicate Transactions', 'Transaction not recognized', 'Suspected Fraud', 'Others'. Present these as options to the customer and map their choice to the exact value.
